meta.name: Mechanical watch movement
meta.description: A hand-wound movement: barrel, going train, Swiss lever escapement and a 3 Hz balance, with real tooth counts.

parts.label: Main plate
parts.description: Base of the movement; every arbor pivots in jewels set into it.

parts.label: Mainspring barrel
parts.description: Holds the coiled mainspring; its toothed rim drives the whole going train.

parts.label: Mainspring barrel arbor
parts.description: Steel axle whose pivots run in synthetic ruby jewels.

parts.label: Mainspring barrel jewel
parts.description: Synthetic ruby bearing: hard, smooth and self-lubricating for decades.

parts.label: Centre wheel
parts.description: Turns once an hour and carries the minute hand through the cannon pinion.

parts.label: Centre wheel pinion
parts.description: 10-leaf pinion driven by the previous wheel in the train.

parts.label: Centre wheel arbor
parts.description: Steel axle whose pivots run in synthetic ruby jewels.

parts.label: Centre wheel jewel
parts.description: Synthetic ruby bearing: hard, smooth and self-lubricating for decades.

parts.label: Third wheel
parts.description: Intermediate wheel that steps the speed up between the centre and seconds wheels.

parts.label: Third wheel pinion
parts.description: 8-leaf pinion driven by the previous wheel in the train.

parts.label: Third wheel arbor
parts.description: Steel axle whose pivots run in synthetic ruby jewels.

parts.label: Third wheel jewel
parts.description: Synthetic ruby bearing: hard, smooth and self-lubricating for decades.

parts.label: Fourth (seconds) wheel
parts.description: Turns exactly once a minute; the small-seconds hand rides on its arbor.

parts.label: Fourth pinion
parts.description: 8-leaf pinion driven by the previous wheel in the train.

parts.label: Fourth arbor
parts.description: Steel axle whose pivots run in synthetic ruby jewels.

parts.label: Fourth jewel
parts.description: Synthetic ruby bearing: hard, smooth and self-lubricating for decades.

parts.label: Escape wheel
parts.description: Released one half-tooth per beat by the pallet fork: the source of the tick.

parts.label: Escape wheel pinion
parts.description: 7-leaf pinion driven by the previous wheel in the train.

parts.label: Escape wheel arbor
parts.description: Steel axle whose pivots run in synthetic ruby jewels.

parts.label: Escape wheel jewel
parts.description: Synthetic ruby bearing: hard, smooth and self-lubricating for decades.

parts.label: Mainspring
parts.description: Coiled power source; it unwinds over ~40 hours as the barrel turns.

parts.label: Pallet fork
parts.description: Rocks with the balance, locking and releasing the escape wheel one tooth-half per beat.

parts.label: Balance wheel
parts.description: The regulator: swings back and forth 6 times a second (21,600 beats per hour).

parts.label: Balance arm 1
parts.description: Spoke joining the balance rim to its staff.

parts.label: Balance arm 2
parts.description: Spoke joining the balance rim to its staff.

parts.label: Balance arm 3
parts.description: Spoke joining the balance rim to its staff.

parts.label: Hairspring
parts.description: Flat spiral spring that pulls the balance back to centre and sets its frequency.

parts.label: Balance cock
parts.description: Bridge holding the balance staff’s upper jewel.

parts.label: Cannon pinion
parts.description: Friction-fit on the centre arbor; carries the minute hand and drives the motion works.

parts.label: Minute wheel
parts.description: 36 teeth on the cannon pinion, with a 10-leaf pinion that drives the hour wheel.

parts.label: Hour wheel
parts.description: Completes the 12:1 reduction and carries the hour hand.

parts.label: Crown and stem
parts.description: Winds the mainspring and sets the hands when pulled out.

parts.label: Crown
parts.description: Knurled knob turned by your fingers.
